label: 景观松树
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent PNG for the 2D/2.5D Chinese tea-village game 茶园物语.
Style: clean Chinese ink outline with pale hand-painted watercolor fills, harmonizing with the approved references. Simple large clear shapes, controlled sparse brush marks, thin charcoal/brown linework; avoid dense texture or paper grain. Restrained ivory #EEE5D5, sage #83957E, tea green #526C62, charcoal #5C6261, pale timber #967653, bamboo #C5A36F, occasional dusty coral #B76651.
For constructed objects use elevated parallel dimetric 2:1 ground axes, diagonal edges slope about ±26.565 degrees, verticals remain vertical, near and far edges stay parallel, no lens perspective. Soft even light, modest internal shading, no cast ground shadow.
Output actual RGBA transparency outside the subject. Full silhouette, visible generous transparent margin on ALL four sides; never crop. No background fill, checkerboard, paper sheet, black background, white background, vignette, glow, halo, text, calligraphy, numerals, UI, labels, borders, watermark. No extra props, people, scenery, repeated objects or decorative clutter. Avoid oversaturation, muddy gradients, noise, excessive fiber or woodgrain, photorealism, heavy black outline and strong reflections. Preserve clear edges at small gameplay sizes.
Primary request: ONLY one mature Jiangnan landscape pine tree, fully independent actual transparent PNG, no ground. Input1 provides the gently irregular pine silhouettes of the tea village; Input2 establishes clean sage foliage watercolor and thin brown linework, but do not include lotus parts.
Subject: one gracefully bending brown-grey trunk, modest natural curves, a few visible main branches, FIVE to SEVEN broad horizontal umbrella-shaped soft sage/tea-green pine-needle canopy masses. Silhouette airy with clear negative gaps between the large canopy layers. Needles indicated by a few grouped short strokes along edges, NOT thousands of tiny individual needles. Sparse broad trunk strokes, no dense bark fissures. Root base simple visible short flared trunk end, not a huge exposed root system.
Full-size scenery tree, NOT miniature bonsai. Mild elevated3/4 game view compatible with dimetric village. Portrait1024×1536, canopy and roots occupy at most75% canvas width and80% height; generous transparent padding on all sides. Entire top branch tips and trunk base complete.
No soil, rock, pot, planter, stump platform, grass, shrubs, moss, other trees, hanging objects, lantern, people, birds, cloud, gold ornament, text or cast shadow. Low saturation, strong readable trunk/canopy silhouette, no muddiness or stippling.
